### [component] Onboarding Stepper Progress  [id: 19143]
by shadcnspace
An onboarding progress tracker with a step counter, percentage completion bar, and back/next navigation buttons.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/shadcnspace/progress-02/default/preview.1783694619073.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/shadcnspace/progress-02?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 19143 })

### [component] Onboarding Timeline  [id: 29486]
by ephraimduncan
A vertical timeline component that shows deployment/onboarding steps with done, in-progress, and upcoming states.

install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ephraimduncan/onboarding-06?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 29486 })

### [component] Stepper  [id: 28565]
by corr
A horizontal or vertical step indicator that shows progress through install, publish, or multi-step form flows.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/corr/stepper/default/preview.1789988654749-0893ec09-b0ac-420d-be3a-3b7111baa958.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/corr/stepper?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 28565 })

### [component] Step Onboarding Wizard  [id: 29526]
by ziegfiroyt
A multi-step onboarding wizard with square numbered step indicators and a content card that walks users through product setup or feature introductions.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ziegfiroyt/onboarding9/default/preview.1790087072613-3599e25e-3014-41fb-b679-21c39786bbd0.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ziegfiroyt/onboarding9?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 29526 })

### [component] Stepper  [id: 3734]
by sean0205
A step-by-step process for users to navigate through a series of steps.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_2wpPk1CyWKAxM46S7k5UoCQhmqF/stepper/vertical/preview.1786987108676.webp
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/sean0205/stepper?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 3734 })

### [component] Basic Stepper  [id: 29925]
by sean0205
A horizontal multi-step progress indicator with numbered circle indicators and separators, used to guide users through a sequence of steps like a checkout or onboarding flow.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/sean0205/c-stepper-1/default/preview.1790140579944-e8d24f3b-9e74-4eb7-b83a-9271009b1b68.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/sean0205/c-stepper-1?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 29925 })

### [component] Vertical Titled Stepper  [id: 29815]
by sean0205
A vertical multi-step progress stepper that shows numbered steps with titles, a connecting line, and a check/loading indicator for completed or active steps.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/sean0205/c-stepper-15/default/preview.1790123323203-6cdc11c5-9929-4a80-81c7-8bc17d3c1a9e.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/sean0205/c-stepper-15?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 29815 })

### [component] Stepper  [id: 35237]
by kevingirelli
An accessible multi-step progress indicator for flows like checkout or onboarding, showing which steps are complete, current, or upcoming, with optional clickable triggers.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_registry_kevingirelli_1790903224160/stepper/default/preview.1791206206769.webp
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/kevingirelli/stepper?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 35237 })

### [component] Onboarding Steps with Progress  [id: 29458]
by ephraimduncan
A clickable step-by-step onboarding checklist with a progress bar for guiding users through setup tasks like creating a store or launching a product.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ephraimduncan/onboarding-03/default/preview.1790080272307-b19a26d4-f7a6-4ae7-a17c-49a0dd48924c.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ephraimduncan/onboarding-03?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 29458 })

### [component] Stepper with Square Badges  [id: 28546]
by shadcnspace
A multi-step form indicator with animated progress line, checkmarks for completed steps, and back/next/reset controls for guiding users through account setup or onboarding flows.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/shadcnspace/stepper-01/default/preview.1789986786825-6fc7c015-c74b-4e1a-b38a-085d3cdd6380.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/shadcnspace/stepper-01?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 28546 })
